ВАЖНО про формат FINAL: отвечай на том же языке, на котором задан вопрос, и копируй формулировку максимально близко к найденному источнику - не переводи и не перефразируй. Если источник на английском, а вопрос тоже на английском (или явно про англоязычный факт), FINAL должен быть на английском, дословно как в источнике: имена, названия, цитаты - без перевода на русский. Для дат пиши в формате 'число месяц' без года, если год не спрашивают явно (например, '15 March', а не '15 март' и не 'March 15, 2026'). Для чисел с приставками (трлн/млрд/млн, T/B/M) используй ту же запись и тот же язык, что были бы уместны в источнике, не переводи единицы измерения. Если факт в источнике выражен как соотношение или с уточнением (например, '4 of 5', 'nine of 27'), приведи его в FINAL полностью, а не только первое число.

The Poly Beijing 2026 Spring Auction was an auction held from May to July 2026. The auction achieved a total turnover of 620 million yuan, representing an increase of 14.81% compared to the 2025 Spring Auction; it produced 8 lots valued in the tens of millions and 75 lots valued in the millions. Several private collection sessions and special topics, entrusted by collectors, spanned various business segments and were successfully presented during this season's spring auction. 1 Chinese name 北京保利2026春季拍卖会 Event Date May 2026 to July 2026 Event Timeline The Poly Beijing 2026 Spring Auction was held from May to July 2026. Event Content The Chinese Painting and Calligraphy Section featured five special sessions, with a total turnover of 115 million yuan, generating one lot exceeding ten million yuan and fifteen lots exceeding one million yuan. The Chinese Painting and Calligraphy Night Auction produced one lot exceeding ten million yuan and eleven lots exceeding one million yuan. Zhang Daqian's 1968 masterpiece from his Badayuan period, Five Pavilion Mountain Scenery · Running Script Fengdie Seven-Character Poem , sold for 17.25 million yuan. The work employs a rare technique of vermilion splashed color and has a clear provenance. Pan Tianshou 's Imitating the Brushwork of Bada was hammered down at 8.05 million yuan after more than ten rounds of bidding. This work was once used as an illustration in the artist's theoretical article, making it highly representative of his creative output. Additionally, one of Zhang Daqian's twelve landscape screens in the archaic style, Imitating Shen Zifan's Silk Tapestry Painting , from the original collector's family and appearing on the market for the first time in over eighty years, sold for 7.59 million yuan after over thirty rounds of bidding.
